notes.title: Faster run speed, world map, more tolerable baby, item placement, and bugfixes.
notes.content:
Been hard at work these last few days, but the biggest improvements have come with the simplest adjustments. 

QUALITY OF LIFE
- Player run speed is faster. By a lot. 
- There's now a world map with cardinal directions and player marker. 
- Hushing the baby now keeps the baby quieter for longer when you hush after it stops crying. 
- Holding F lets you place items down at exact spots, wherever you're looking. 
- Some small world building details to offer player hints (as to what kind of paths they might want to inspect).

BUG FIXES
- Some bugs related to overlapping endings, or endings getting cancelled out from certain events triggering at the same time. 
- More fixes related to pesky "Husband-chase-the-hare" issues. 
- Update interaction texts, other clean up for text formatting.

notes.content:

- Misc collisions (bed, neighbors homes, etc)
- Fixed missing interaction text for some objects.
- Old lady repeating dialog after delivery.
- Husband death glitch on walk home.

QUALITY OF LIFE:

- More ravens.
- Door lock reminder regardless of state.

notes.title: Dec 2nd 2024 - Little bugs fixed and Dialog UI quality of life improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Bugs and quality of life changes[/h1]

QUALITY OF LIFE:
- Skip option for dialog. 
- Dialog UI scroll speed more responsive. 
- Additional interaction text for some objects. 

BUGS FIXED:
- Some instances of footsteps continuing when husband was gone for work. 
- An ending that didn't return to main menu after. 
- Bible UI would get stuck if dropped or switched while reading. 
- Bed collider problems. 
- Neighbor house collider problems.
